text: Fresh third reproducer on an exact standalone clone: checkout fed6c178eb1924aa5240ba875f978bb16fe20625, base f888f9aecbf51bb5c5c10254a846df77650d3e27, then bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE HEAD. The tool correctly finds embed-bench and embed-onnx consumers but emits sbt -batch "embedBench/test; embedOnnxJVM/test". embedOnnx is JVM-only in build.sbt jvmOnlyModules and has no embedOnnxJVM project. The script comment and sbt_id case still know only embed-bench and embed-grakern. Acceptance court must pin embed-onnx -> embedOnnx and should derive or at least test the full current JVM-only list so the next module does not reopen the defect. Probe clone: /private/tmp/reference-scope-probe.Fh29j0/repo; no repository edit.
